notes.title: New Character Available Now!
notes.notes:
We’ve just released a free update for Monster Meals, and it comes with a special new character: Paschoalin!

He’s got a big mustache and an even bigger appetite — and he’s ready to show up at your food truck looking for a monstrous meal.

This new customer is part of our ongoing plan to bring even more fun (and chaos) to Monster Meals.
Hop in, serve fast, and don’t keep him waiting…

Update your game and meet Paschoalin today!

notes.title: 🔥 Monster Meals now has ONLINE MULTIPLAYER! 🔥
notes.notes:
It’s here! Online multiplayer has arrived in Monster Meals! 🎉 Now you and your friends can cook together, no matter where you are!

💀 Work together (or get eaten) – The kitchen chaos is real! Split tasks, serve monstrous customers on time, and avoid becoming dinner!

🍖 Online hunting – Track down bizarre ingredients, process them, and complete orders before customers lose their patience.

👨‍🍳 Easy matchmaking – Invite friends, join games using a room code, or jump into public matches to cook with players worldwide!

Multiplayer is available now! Grab your friends, sharpen your knives, and get cooking! 🔪🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050138/59865969a5207cdc70784b7bddb3daeb1f72f2dc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Monster Meals - Online Multiplayer Beta is Here!
notes.notes:
The Online Multiplayer Beta is officially available! We’re thrilled to offer this update to our community. Now you can create public or private matches, invite friends through Steam or room code, and join matches with players from around the world.

To participate in the beta, simply open Monster Meals in your Steam Library. Right-click the game or click the gear icon to access the Properties menu. In the Betas tab, under Beta Participation, select "1.1.0-beta - Multiplayer online beta". The game will update automatically.

By joining the beta, you’re helping us test and improve the new multiplayer mode. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we finalize the update for the official release.

Help us test and make the online experience even better! Play, report bugs, and share your thoughts.

notes.title: Monster Meals Turns 1 Month Old!
notes.notes:
It’s been a month since Monster Meals launched, and we want to thank everyone who played, had fun, and supported the game! 🧡🐙 It’s been amazing to see so many players cooking (and running from hungry customers) during this time.

We’re thrilled with the results: nearly 1,000 copies sold and 100% positive reviews! This means a lot for a small studio like ours.

And there’s more to come! We’re working on new content and updates to make the game even better. Thank you for being part of this journey! 🍽️✨

notes.title: Monster Meals is now available!
notes.notes:
After a lot of dedication and hard work, we're excited to announce that **Monster Meals** is now available for everyone!

notes.title: The Full Kitchen of Monster Meals!
notes.notes:
Step into the Full Kitchen and unleash the ultimate **Monster Meals** experience with this bundle, which includes:

- **Monster Meals Base Game**: Cook, serve, and survive the hungry monster madness.
- **Legendary Arsenal DLC**: Wield 5 epic weapons inspired by gaming's greatest legends.

Whether you're a monster chef newbie or a seasoned kitchen master, this all-in-one collection is your golden ticket to culinary chaos, wild fun, and unforgettable adventures.

notes.notes:
We have some amazing news to share: Monster Meals has been selected as part of the official lineup of the Latin American Games Showcase! 🥳

📅 The event runs from December 10th to 17th, celebrating incredible games from Latin America. We’re honored to stand alongside so many talented creators from the region and can’t wait to showcase Monster Meals to even more people!

Stay tuned for updates during the event. Thank you for all the support that brought us this far! 💜

notes.title: Join Monster Meals in the Steam Cooking Fest – Wishlist, Play, and Share!
notes.notes: Monster Meals is part of the Steam Cooking Fest! We're excited to invite you to play our demo, add the game to your wishlist, and share your experience with us. We’re bringing a fresh twist to the cooking genre, with innovative gameplay that's unlike any other. Dive into the world of monster chefs and serve up dishes to keep your monstrous customers satisfied – if you’re up for the challenge, join us now!

notes.title: Happy Halloween from Monster Meals!
notes.notes: Happy Halloween, everyone! The Monster Meals team wishes you a fun Halloween full of frights and treats. Development is in full swing, and we’re excited to share updates soon. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Exciting Announcement: Monster Meals Joins the DevGAMM Awards 2024!
notes.notes:
🎉 Exciting News! 🎉
Monster Meals has been selected for the DevGAMM Awards 2024! 🏆

We're thrilled to be part of this event, celebrating indie games around the world. If you're following the awards, keep an eye out for Monster Meals in the lineup! 👾

Thanks for all the support so far—this journey wouldn't be possible without you! 🙌

notes.title: Monster Meals is fully compatible with Steam Deck! Tested and approved
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I’m excited to announce that Monster Meals is fully compatible with Steam Deck! I personally own a Steam Deck and have done all the tests to make sure the game runs perfectly on it. No issues at all – smooth gameplay and ready for your monster cooking adventures!

To show you how it plays, I’ve recorded a video of myself enjoying the game on Steam Deck. Check it out below:

[previewyoutube=eZKIe3QpeDE;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're a Steam Deck owner, get ready to cook up some monster meals on the go!

notes.title: Monster Meals Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that the Monster Meals demo is now available for download! Dive into culinary adventures and test your skills in a world full of hungry creatures.

In the demo, you’ll get the chance to:

[list]
[*][b]Hunt Animals:[/b] Find wild creatures and turn them into ingredients for your monstrous meals.
[*][b]Cook and Serve:[/b] Use your culinary skills to prepare delicious dishes and serve them to demanding customers.
[*][b]Team Up:[/b] Play solo or with a friend in cooperative mode, tackling challenges that require teamwork and strategy.
[/list]

Don’t miss the chance to experience Monster Meals before the full release! Download the demo now and let us know what you think. We’re excited to hear your feedback and make the game even better.

And don’t forget to add Monster Meals to your wishlist to stay updated on all news and the full release!

Get ready to cook, serve, and survive!

notes.title: Join Us at RetroCon 2024!
notes.notes:
Hello, Monster Meals fans!

We’re excited to announce that we’ll be participating in RetroCon, one of the most anticipated events of the year for all gaming enthusiasts! 🎮✨

[b]📅 Date:[/b] August 3rd and 4th, 2024  
[b]📍 Location:[/b] São Paulo-SP - Centro de Eventos Pro Magno

Come visit us at booth [b]L72[/b] for an exclusive Monster Meals experience! We’ll have a new version of our demo with exciting updates! It’s the perfect chance to play, interact with the team, and give your feedback on the game!

[b]What you can expect:[/b]

- [b]Live demonstration[/b] of Monster Meals with thrilling new features!
- [b]Meet and greet[/b] with the development team.

We can’t wait to see you there and share our passion for Monster Meals. Don’t miss the chance to connect with other fans and experience the game firsthand. See you at RetroCon!

For more details about the event, follow us on social media and stay tuned for updates!

See you soon!

The Giant Warrior Studio Team
